thesis: A net-cash pharma with rising returns and margins trades low in its own EV/EBITDA and P/FCF ranges while in a healthy uptrend.
reason: Thesis intact: ROIC and operating margin at 2-year highs, net cash, FCF yield 10.43%; the rolling FCF dip is timing, not profitability. No new evidence since the 2026-11-18 entry and the position sits close to its target size, so hold rather than add.

triggers.text: TTM operating margin falls below 28%, reversing most of the rise from 28.7% a year earlier to 34.5%.
TTM ROIC falls below 16%, back to the FY2021 level and erasing the returns improvement.
TTM FCF margin falls below 18%, showing the rolling slide from 29.3% is structural, not timing.
Net debt/EBITDA (ratios page) rises above 1.0x from -0.61x, signalling a debt-funded deal.
